## The problem
What is missing today, or what is painful?

## Proposed solution
How would you like it to work?

## Alternatives considered
Any other way you've seen it handled (e.g. clipboard managers on other
platforms)?

## Notes
Keep the single-file constraint in mind (see CONTRIBUTING.md) — if your
feature needs a new dependency or module, explain why in the request.
